description: Authoritative license evidence for Avalonia, AvaloniaEdit, DataGrid, HarfBuzzSharp, and SkiaSharp packages. Entries establish evidence and do not assert that every RID/build package is shipped.

entries.evidenceNotes: The signed 12.0.4 tag resolves to the version commit. MIT requires preservation of the copyright and permission notice. Explicit names avoid accidentally covering separately licensed native/font packages or unrelated Avalonia-prefixed packages.

The authoritative 11.3.2 licence.md has Git blob 41951805ac6a5cdb91373db7725fbaa9c004d912, exactly identical to the deduplicated Avalonia MIT text retained for 12.0.4. This is a build-only package and mapping it does not assert that it ships.

Package code is Avalonia MIT and embeds Inter font binaries licensed OFL-1.1. OFL section 2 requires each redistributed copy to contain the copyright notice and license. The Avalonia source tag does not record the Inter release used; rsms/inter v4.1 supplies authoritative current OFL text, but no exact Inter source ref was established for the embedded font binaries.
The 12.0.0 tag resolves to the package version commit. Preserve Eli Arbel's copyright and the MIT permission notice.
The signed 12.0.0 tag resolves to the version commit. MIT requires preservation of the AvaloniaUI OU copyright and permission notice.

HarfBuzzSharp bindings are released from mono/SkiaSharp under MIT. NativeAssets package version 8.3.1.3 carries HarfBuzz 8.3.1; upstream cgmanifest.json at v3.119.4 identifies that native version. HarfBuzz's old-MIT text requires its copyright and license paragraphs in all copies. The release-tagged External-Dependency-Info.txt is the authoritative consolidated notice and must accompany redistributed native assets. Pattern matching establishes evidence only; it must not be interpreted as proof that Linux, macOS, WebAssembly, Win32, or other RID packages are present in a particular published artifact.

SkiaSharp's managed binding is MIT. NativeAssets binaries incorporate Skia and third-party material with additional licenses and attribution conditions enumerated verbatim in External-Dependency-Info.txt; the notice is required evidence in addition to the package-level MIT text. The v3.119.4 tag pins mono/skia commit 330baf49f60f4354d6e3fdb6ce526c08926c7c37 in cgmanifest.json. Pattern matching establishes evidence only and must not mark wrong-RID/build packages as shipped.
